svg.title: A Halloween evening that welcomes everyone

text.tspan: Everyday English - B2 - 2026/10/26 - Essay - 01
A costume creates a playful Halloween character.
Pexels · 29225548
A Halloween evening that welcomes everyone
A good way to prepare a Halloween evening combines practical structure with an awareness of other people. Neither a rigid plan nor
complete improvisation is sufficient on its own; both need to be judged in context.
The practical case is straightforward: planning the route and the costumes helps everyone stay comfortable. Consider how we check
that costumes allow clear vision and choose a well-lit route. The benefit is not merely efficiency. A modest arrangement prevents
avoidable confusion, leaving attention available for the activity itself rather than for problems that could have been anticipated.
Consideration adds a second, equally important dimension: clear choices make sharing treats more considerate. In this situation, we
keep ingredient information available and offer a non-food option. A decision can be convenient for one person while creating difficulty
for another, so its value depends partly on whose needs it recognises.
The most useful approach therefore brings structure and consideration together. Preparation establishes a workable starting point;
attention to other people keeps it responsive. Success should be assessed by how well the arrangement serves the experience,
rather than by how closely events follow the original plan.
BUILD YOUR OWN · State a clear main idea; develop two different points with examples; bring them together in the conclusion. Each
body paragraph needs a distinct point and a concrete example. The conclusion should connect the argument rather than introduce a
new proposal.
Identify two obstacles that could arise when people prepare a Halloween evening. Explain a workable response to each, rather than
merely listing the problems. Use four short paragraphs: introduction, two developed points, and conclusion.
